item.title: Oil built the Persian Gulf. Desalinated water keeps it alive. War could threaten both
item.description: By ANNIKA HAMMERSCHLAG As missiles and drones curtail energy production across the Persian Gulf, analysts warn that water, not oil, may be the resource most at risk in the energy-rich but arid region.
